title: Credential Contract
description: Credential classes and non-secret credential metadata (spec 6.1). Classes are independent: no credential is reused across trust domains (RTB-04). Secret material never appears in any contract, URL, query string, argument or log.

LocalClientToken.description: Wire form of a local-client bearer token: 32 random bytes, base64url without padding (DV-RTB-TOKEN-ENCODING, at least 256 bits of entropy).

CredentialMetadata.description: Metadata only. Credentials are independently revocable and rotatable.
